snippet.title: Legends of the Round Table - Official Gameplay | The Most Immersive Arthurian RPG
snippet.description:
Discover the unique gameplay of Legends of the Round Table, a narrative strategic RPG that plunges you into the world of King Arthur and his Knights.

You'll manage the Round Table, guide its Knights through exciting adventures inspired by real medieval tales and rewrite the legends through the choices you make.

👑Wishlist on Steam: https://bit.ly/3TTCnLZ
💬Discord: https://roundtablegame.com/Discord
